# Features

ThreatLVL is a tool for game masters. Here is what it does, and what is on the way.
*Planned* means designed and scoped; none of these statuses implies a date.

## Running the game

| Feature | Status |
|---|---|
| **Room & membership model**<br>A Room is a campaign instance — a persistent world a GM hosts. Users belong to any number of Rooms, each with a GM or Player role. | In Progress |
| **Event log**<br>An append-only record of everything that happens in a Room — chat, dice rolls, actions, movement, map positions, whispers, dialog, and narration. | In Progress |
| **Combat encounter loop**<br>Starting an encounter, resolving each round, and ending it — the loop a GM drives during a fight. | Planned |
| **Character progression**<br>Awarding experience and levelling characters up, gated by the `experience` Cargo feature. | In Progress |
| **Dice subsystem**<br>Programmatic dice, toggleable per Room — and externally-rolled results accepted as first-class input, so a table that prefers physical dice loses nothing. | In Progress |
| **D&D 5e (2014) ruleset**<br>The D&D 5e 2014 rules, from SRD 5.1 — the base edition everything else is measured against. | In Progress |
| **D&D 5e 2024 edition deltas**<br>D&D 5e 2024 ('5.5e') support, modelled as deltas layered over the 2014 base rather than a second copy of the rules. | In Progress |
| **Pathfinder ruleset**<br>Pathfinder 1e as a tier-1 system, licensed under ORC. | In Progress |
| **GURPS ruleset**<br>GURPS 4e as a tier-1 system. | In Progress |
| **Success at a Cost**<br>A failed or marginal check can resolve as success with a GM-defined complication instead of a flat failure. | Planned |
| **Vehicle & ship combat scale**<br>Ships, vehicles and mechs as combatants with crew stations, so several players act aboard one combatant on a single initiative slot. | Planned |
| **Depletion tracks**<br>Named, pluggable resource pools beyond hit points — shields against hull, heat, power, ammo and reload, sanity or stress or corruption — each with its own depletion and recovery rules. | Planned |
| **Shared resource pools**<br>Momentum/Threat-style pools owned by the table or by the GM rather than by any single character. | Planned |
| **Range bands**<br>Band and zone distance as a first-class positional representation, not something derived from grid coordinates. | Planned |
| **Loadouts**<br>Slotted, modular gear — hardpoints, power draw, attachment slots — sitting alongside the weight- limited encumbrance model rather than replacing it. | Planned |
| **Voice & narration recording**<br>Capturing and storing session audio, gated so the platform is fully playable without it. | Planned |
| **Map sidecar**<br>Visual scene and positional rendering with character pins — an optional sidecar, never a requirement for play. | Planned |
| **VTT integration**<br>A bridge to Roll20, Foundry and other virtual tabletops, for groups who want to keep the map workflow they already have. | Planned |

## Campaign content

| Feature | Status |
|---|---|
| **IR read-aloud, secrets & loot tables**<br>The GM-facing structures a published adventure actually contains: read-aloud text, GM-only secrets, and rollable loot tables. | Planned |
| **Book ingestion pipeline**<br>Turning a published campaign book into provenance-tagged, structured content the engine can run - so a GM can use the books they already own. | In Progress |

## Playing together

| Feature | Status |
|---|---|
| **GM and Player roles**<br>GM and Player as distinct roles, with the capability difference enforced by the engine rather than the interface. | In Progress |
| **Room invite flow**<br>How a GM gets players into a Room — invitation, acceptance, and role assignment. | Planned |
| **Character sheet creation & sync**<br>Players build character sheets that live in the engine, persist across sessions, and are visible to the GM. | In Progress |
| **Real-time multiplayer session**<br>A GM and their players in one Room, seeing each other's actions as they happen. | In Progress |
| **Cashless free play**<br>Running a game requires no payment of any kind. No card, no subscription, no trial clock. | Planned |

## For creators

| Feature | Status |
|---|---|

| **Campaign sales**<br>Authors sell campaign ebooks; the platform takes a revenue share. | Planned |

## GM assistant

| Feature | Status |
|---|---|
| **LLM combat & tactical support**<br>LLM Phase A: suggesting monster actions in combat, which the GM accepts, rejects or embellishes. | Planned |
| **LLM storytelling suggestions**<br>LLM Phase B: proposing scene narration drawn from book content and current game state, for the GM to take or leave. | Planned |
| **LLM NPC cognition**<br>LLM Phase C: per-creature motivations, tactics and capability, so a dragon and a goblin pack think differently in identical circumstances. | Planned |
| **GM supervision workflow**<br>Inspect, accept, reject, embellish or re-roll — the affordances through which every LLM suggestion passes before it becomes real. | Planned |

## Optional by design

Dice, maps, voice recording and the GM assistant are all optional subsystems, and the
game stays fully playable with any of them turned off. A table that rolls physical dice
loses nothing: the engine treats externally-rolled results as first-class input.
